source_shape: Colored featureless head at upper-left/center, separated upper torso and hip-form marks over a pale central stem with split base supports. Pale angled marks on the right and colored marks left of the torso are ambiguous arm/armature cues, not proof of extra limbs or a game actor skeleton.

palette.rule: Head/torso/hip shell and colored left bent-form marks receive actual native randomized detail. Stem/base/right armature remain primary y. Cyan in authoring only identifies shell ownership; final production layers are neutral. Default R preview is a blueprint illustration, not a claimed captured random result.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed CombatTrainingDummy_south supplies restrained featureless dummy/form contours, shallow surface shading and stand readability only. Its X eyes, target circles, soft sack shape, donor training behavior and source colors are not copied.

reference_limits: VFE Vikings training dummy was viewed but not selected: helmet, shield and sword would change source identity. No exact wood/fiberglass tailoring mannequin equivalent was found in inspected named assets.
construction: Retain actual selected front material and shell ownership in expanded frame; author reverse of featureless forms about source stand. Separate complete profiles preserve intrinsic colored left bent form versus pale right armature, head/torso/hip fragments, central stem and splayed supports. Profile depth/overlap/unseen surfaces remain interpretation. No face, hands/fingers, walking legs, target, modern human mannequin or new clothing system.

native_state.rule: RandomColors DetailColor=all resolves with Crayons.GetRandomColorAll and writes native Render.DetailColor. Keep actual chosen color native. One ordinary fixed tile is declared; rare Animated builder/BodyType WoodenHumanoid is a separate native behavior and requires original fallback.

equipment_boundary: Ordinary mannequin definition declares no Mannequin-specific clothing/apparel render path. BodyType is animated-furniture metadata, not a reusable human actor body, independent arm/leg render nodes or proof of wearable equipment. This entry converts the static furniture graphic only.

frame.rule: Shared expanded frame adds4source units each side of the original cell; original physical pixels/scale retained. Reflect N about standx11.3 to preserve rotation pivot and fit the source long armature. No per-view/part alpha-bounds normalization; all masks share mapping.

native_behavior: Preserve mounted30-weight non-solid furniture, AV2,Hitpoints80, source non-takeability and rare animated/custom fallback. No donor training mechanics or new clothing framework.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; native random detail selection, mounted non-solid30-weight furniture/AV2/HP80, visibility and rare Animated fallback plus extra-view placement remain unfinished.

directional_reference.footprint: No explicit size in inspected CombatDummy/BuildingBase XML; runtime default unknown.
directional_reference.mapping: Exact1.6CombatDummy texPath matches root CombatTrainingDummy S/E/N textures. No LoadFolders.xml installed; activation/profile not asserted.
directional_reference.role: Actual featureless form silhouette, complete profile head volume and shallow shading only. Donor X eyes/target/sack silhouette/training are not copied; source stand/armature geometry is not supplied by this sack reference.

camera.contract: Selected straight front retained; N is the same featureless manufactured forms reversed about the central stand, not the image midpoint. Complete east and west profiles are authored separately for asymmetric limb/role overlap. No humanoid actor pose or face.
camera.dimension_provenance: Unseen form thickness, profile armature depth/occlusion and stand strut directions are authored estimates informed by native biped-form glyph/description and actual donor profile volume; not native dimensions or a donor frame ratio.
camera.west: Separate profile: pale right armature is far, colored left form is near. A mirror of the entire east would swap source role/laterality incorrectly.
